facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication and Information Technology reported that the Steering Committee overseeing the National High-Speed Internet Communication Strategy (Mkakati wa Taifa wa Mawasiliano ya Intaneti ya Kasi) held its first meeting on 25 June 2026 in Dodoma, chaired by the Ministry's Permanent Secretary; the document gives no plan period.
facts.system: Mkakati wa Taifa wa Mawasiliano ya Intaneti ya Kasi
